newsitem.title: USA: "Smart card" technology vendors form alliance.
newsitem.headline: "Smart card" technology vendors form alliance.

text.p: A group of "smart card" technology vendors said they have formed an alliance to produce and market multiapplication platforms for college and corporate campuses, stadiums, resorts, and other closed venues across the U.S.
The alliance is comprised of CyberMark LLC, Debitek Inc, Gemplus Corp, Product Technologies Inc, VeriFone Inc, V-ONE Corp, and 3G International Inc.

The alliance's smart card technology is a fully expandable platform that supports multiple card issuers, secure off-line and on-line transactions, multiple purses, debit and credit purses, multiple currencies, and multiple applications, all on a single card. It allows for as many applications as the issuing institution wants to make available and that the end-user desires to use.
The companies said the closed-system market represents immediate business opportunities, and also will be important for understanding smart card usage patterns as open systems evolve in the U.S.
